parse_xml_file: parse an XML file into an etree Element with blank text removed for pretty printing
find_element_by_tag_and_name: find an XML element by its tag and name attribute within an etree root
create_nested_element: create a deeply nested XML element structure by recursively appending copies of an element
review_find_element: review the find_element function that locates XML elements using XPath queries by tag and name
summarize_parse: summarize the parse function that reads XML files with a whitespace-removing parser
